    73	// observeToTokenEvent maps an observe.Event into the legacy TokenEvent shape

    78	// (modify/execute/search/network/coordinate) so the dashboard's TYPE column
    79	// distinguishes Edit ("modify") from Read ("read"). The well-known consume
    80	// subtypes (file/outline/symbol/avoided) keep their legacy names so existing
    81	// callers and the Stats aggregator continue to recognise them.
    82	func observeToTokenEvent(e *observe.Event) *memory.TokenEvent {

    84		switch e.Kind {
    85		case observe.KindHook:
    86			if e.Name != "output-transform" || e.Category != "transform" {

    96			case e.Category == "consume" && e.Subtype == "avoided":
    97				eventType = memory.TokenEventReadAvoided
    98			case e.Category == "consume" && e.Subtype == "file":
    99				eventType = memory.TokenEventRead

   102			default:
   103				return nil
   104			}

   107		default:
   108			return nil
   109		}
   110		te := &memory.TokenEvent{
   111			Attrs:       e.Attrs,
   112			ID:          e.ID,
   113			SessionID:   e.SessionID,
   114			Timestamp:   e.Timestamp,
   115			EventType:   eventType,
   116			Tool:        e.Name,
   117			FilePath:    e.FilePath,
   118			Tokens:      e.Tokens,
   119			TokensSaved: e.TokensSaved,
   120		}

   125				}
   126			}

   129					te.EndLine = n
   130				}
   131			}
   132		}

   139	// the bolt layer from rejecting the write with "key required".

   158			}
   159		}

   162		}

   194							}

   196								e.ID = prior.ID
